name: AI Provider
description: Shared OpenAI-compatible AI backend (Venice by default) that other Cove plugins use for chat, speech, and images.
author: binarygeek119

settings.name: apiKey
settings.description: Bearer token. Falls back to VENICE_API_KEY, then OPENAI_API_KEY, when empty.

settings.name: baseUrl
settings.description: OpenAI-compatible base URL. Default is https://api.venice.ai/api/v1.

settings.name: chatModel
settings.description: Default chat model for plugins that call IAiProvider.ChatAsync.

settings.name: speechModel
settings.description: Default speech model. Default is tts-kokoro.

settings.name: speechVoice
settings.description: Default speech voice. Default is af_sky.

settings.name: speechFormat
settings.description: Default audio format: mp3, opus, aac, flac, or wav.

settings.name: imageModel
settings.description: Default image model. Default is qwen-image-2. Venice uses /image/generate with 16:9.
